name: Ring of Swimming
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 175, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 175, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Aura faint transmutation CL 2nd
Slot ring; Price 2,500 gp; Weight —
Description
This silver ring usually has fishlike designs and motifs etched into the band. It continually grants the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Swim checks.
Construction
Requirements Forge Ring, creator must have 5 ranks in Swim; Cost 1,250 gp
